name: Adult Spinal Deformity
definition: Spectrum of adult scoliosis, kyphosis and sagittal/coronal imbalance causing pain, disability, neural compression or impaired standing balance.

investigations.principle: Standing full-spine radiographs define alignment; MRI/CT are selected for neural, stenotic and bony questions.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery is individualized according to disability, neural compression, alignment and frailty.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Prishtha-vakrata phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Spectrum of adult scoliosis, kyphosis and sagittal/coronal imbalance causing pain, disability, neural compression or impaired standing balance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
